title: Runtime selection and CLI dispatch
objective: Let guided and non-interactive SCORE Runs select OpenCode or Pi, then derive execution solely from the frozen adapter kind.
requirements: One source-registered RuntimeAdapters module owns the closed OpenCode and Pi registrations and returns the matching catalog and RuntimeAdapter layer without a dynamic plugin loader.

Guided start selects a runtime before model discovery, displays runtime-specific model and variant labels, and freezes the selected catalog configuration only after the existing human confirmation gate.
Non-interactive enqueue and start accept --adapter opencode or --adapter pi; omitting --adapter preserves the existing OpenCode default and existing scripts remain compatible.
Work and recovery read the frozen Run adapter kind and construct only its matching runtime layer; unknown, unavailable, or mismatched registrations fail before a Job is claimed or input is delivered.
Generic non-interactive selection validates explicit variants against the selected runtime catalog before Run or Job creation while retaining the current exact-match and single-variant rules.
CLI help, guided confirmation, progress labels, and error text identify the selected runtime without exposing credentials or runtime-specific internal state.
Deterministic tests cover both guided and non-interactive paths, OpenCode default compatibility, Pi selection, frozen dispatch, unknown kinds, variant errors, and pre-claim failure.

skills.name: Small source-registered dispatcher
skills.content: Register exactly OpenCode and Pi in source. Enforce unique IDs at construction. `registrationFor`, `catalogFor`, and `layerFor` fail closed for unsupported IDs and require a registration's id to equal configuration.kind. Keep catalogs separate from execution layers so discovery never creates a session. Do not introduce loading, manifests, capability negotiation, or a mutable global registry.

constraints: This is the only production module allowed to import both concrete adapters.
Do not accept string casts or fallback from an unknown stored kind to OpenCode.
Do not change another file.

Throw labeled errors before enqueue for missing model, missing variant, or ambiguity.
